Marissa / Ben — forwarding Zephyr's request. Two asks from AP: they need legal remit name/address for the invoice sender field, and they want to know whether we can push e-invoice (XML/PEPPOL/SFTP) into their AP system or if we should email PDF+XML.

Current facts:
- We issued a PDF for July (attached) from "Redwood Inference, Inc." using our standard remit address in CA.
- We do generate an XML payload for customers using SFTP/partner integrations but not all accounts are set up automatically.

Options:
1) Treat Zephyr as portal customers: ask them to register for the billing portal (preferred for recurring customers) — portal will push CSV/XML exports to their system and provides the invoice sender metadata.
2) If they need immediate matching, we can push XML via SFTP / send XML+PDF via secure email (we have to confirm encryption and contact).
3) Change sender metadata (if they require a different legal name / remit for tax) — this requires billing ops sign-off and may affect reporting for 1099/VAT.

Ben — can billing ops produce a one-off SFTP push + include the XML for PO 63712 to get them matched this cycle? Also confirm the legal remit line we should use on the invoice. Marissa — if we recommend portal onboarding, can you share the quick registration link and expected timeline?

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
